about_short_description.short_description: Money Protects fintech and financial services company.

product.name: Mortgage EMI Sleeping Period
product.description: A financial product allowing mortgage borrowers to pause EMI payments temporarily while Money Protects covers the payments, providing relief during financial distress.

product.name: Fixed EMI for Life
product.description: A financial product that fixes the EMI amount on mortgages or loans for the entire loan tenure, protecting borrowers from interest rate fluctuations.

product.name: Double Rental/Equity Release
product.description: A financial product enabling property owners to access the equity in their properties and generate a second income stream through rental and reinvestment.

product.name: Wealth Management
product.description: Investment advisory and management services tailored to individual and corporate clients to achieve financial goals across multiple asset classes.
